author: (C. B. Adams, 1850)

note.en: A small ribbed miter shell, up to about 2 cm long, from rubble and rocky bottoms. Known here from 2 museum specimen records[^3].
note.es: Una concha mitra acostillada pequeña, de hasta unos 2 cm, de fondos de escombro y roca. Conocido aquí por 2 registros de ejemplares de museo[^4].

evidence: GBIF: 2 specimen records in the region (Gandoca-Manzanillo refuge, Manzanillo, 2003)

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (museum specimens), Gandoca to Limón
